contexts.text: He is compared to a foolish man ().
They would become foolish more and more...
He had wrought folly in Israel () = what was illicit in their eyes.
Those who were foolish took their lamps and took no oil with them = that they had not the good of charity in their truths. AC 4638:4. AC 4638:5. AE 187:4. AE 840:3. AE 860.
Among fools they might be esteemed wise.
Ye fools and blind... ().
Those are foolish and delirious who are not in the good and truth of the Church...
Folly and insanity, which appear like wisdom and intelligence... constitute the middle degree in the Hells.

The diabolical kingdom consists of those who are in the love of dominion from the love of self, and thence in folly; for... the folly thereof is opposite to celestial wisdom. (Whereas insanity is opposite to spiritual intelligence.)
See Fool.
Hypocrites and the deceitful are much more foolish and senseless than others.
Occurs. DMin 4682.
That afterwards they have no evil from falsity and falsity from evil, is signified by, Let them not turn again to folly ().

The fool speaks folly... (). He is here called a fool who is in falsities and evils from the love of self, and thus from his Own intelligence; the falsities are meant by the folly which he speaks... AE 750:9.

Regarded in itself, cunning and wickedness... are insanity and folly; for they remove themselves from eternal happiness, and conjoin themselves with eternal unhappiness, which is the part of... a madman and a fool. Moreover, all things of heavenly wisdom are in thick darkness with them, and where this wisdom is thick darkness, there is folly.
The foolish people who have spurned His name () = the falsities which are contrary to the truths of doctrine; (for) those who are in falsities are a foolish people.
As where this marriage does not exist there is neither Heaven nor the Church, they are called foolish who know the truths of faith and have not the good of love.
That at last they will have no Knowledges of truth except falsified ones, is signified by, At his last end he shall be a fool ().
To say, Thou fool = to utterly abhor.
With those who are in adulteries, in place of intelligence and wisdom... there are insanities and follies.
5. I saw two ways, one called the way of wisdom and the other the way of folly...
